This individual served as a '''[[death trooper]]''' of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Military|military]]. Stationed onboard [[Freighter 2716]], the [[trooper]] was assigned to guard a [[kyber crystal]] which was to be delivered to [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] under the command of [[DT-F16]]. They were shot by [[Sabine Wren]] when they attempted to fall back with their [[commander]].<ref name="INR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character is voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]], who also voiced [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[AP-5]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.
